reviewEvidence.scope: Historical69mm-face lap rejection and explicit rejected71mm-face replacement joint trials; the latter are not relabelled as source69mm geometry.

detailAssessment.basis: Owning geometric review of the exact worked69mm-face/4550mm-lap reference detail, separate from necessary section-action comparisons.

rejectionReasons.detail: The reference horizontal hoops do not provide a constructible closed-tie assembly through the eight-bar arch/post joint when actual rib/hook envelopes and at-most100mm spacing are included.

The reference near4550mm staggered lap has only13mm ramp: its4mm jog radius lower bound is7.041666667mm against86mm required; the mirrored16mm jog gives1.760416667mm. This is not a feasible formed-bar continuation.

detailAssessment.sectionScreenApplicability: Existing source/geometry checks still govern; passing necessary action screens do not admit the assembly.
detailAssessment.requiredNextProof: Reauthor and geometrically prove the actual joint ties, hook/rib envelopes, transitions and formed lap approaches. A custom cage remains unqualified until its own complete geometry and action applicability are demonstrated.
detailAssessment.scope: The exact default joint assembly is rejected, not merely awaiting fabrication approval.
